Confirm the body's conventions.} noPerDecisionList {This document states no list of its own and the body's present list has no settled meaning, so attendance is not derived for this subject.} other {Presence could not be settled for this subject.}}
messages.CONVENTIONS_UNCONFIRMED: The body's decision conventions were profiled, not confirmed by a person.
messages.UNPLACEABLE_ANCHOR: {kind, select, ARRIVAL {The arrival} other {The departure}} could not be placed: {reason, select, noAgendaItem {the anchor carries no agenda item} noSuchAgendaItem {no subject carries agenda item {detail}} noSuchSubject {subject {detail} is not in the meeting order} decisionNumberNoDigits {decision number «{detail}» has no digits} noDecisionNumbers {no subject of this meeting carries a decision number} decisionNumberBeyond {no subject's decision number reaches {detail}} noOutOfAgenda {the meeting has no out-of-agenda subject} other {the anchor cannot be resolved}}.
messages.IMPLIED_CHANGE: The document lists this member as {status, select, PRESENT {present} other {absent}} but no arrival or departure was stated; the change is implied from here on.
messages.TALLY_MISMATCH: The printed tally disagrees with the derived votes ({diffs}).
messages.INCOMPLETE_READ: The extractor did not reach ΑΠΟΦΑΣΙΖΕΙ; the decision text and the vote may be missing.
messages.PRESIDING_DISAGREES: Documents of this meeting name different presiding members ({names}).
messages.SOURCES_DISAGREE: {kind, select, rollCall {The roll call from {winSource, select, decision {the document} transcript {the transcript} manual {manual entry} other {{winSource}}} says the member is {winStatus, select, PRESENT {present} other {absent}} and the one from {loseSource, select, decision {the document} transcript {the transcript} manual {manual entry} other {{loseSource}}} says {loseStatus, select, PRESENT {present} other {absent}}; the first wins.} event {An arrival and a departure are stated at the same point («{winRawText}» from {winSource, select, decision {the document} transcript {the transcript} manual {manual entry} other {{winSource}}}, «{loseRawText}» from {loseSource, select, decision {the document} transcript {the transcript} manual {manual entry} other {{loseSource}}}); the {winKind, select, ARRIVAL {arrival} other {departure}} wins.} statedList {The document's own list says this member is {status, select, PRESENT {present} other {absent}} here, contradicting the stated {eventKind, select, ARRIVAL {arrival} other {departure}} («{rawText}»); the list wins.} doubleVote {The document names this member twice with different votes ({firstVote, select, FOR {FOR} AGAINST {AGAINST} ABSTAIN {BLANK} PRESENT {PRESENT} DID_NOT_VOTE {DID NOT VOTE} other {{firstVote}}} and {secondVote, select, FOR {FOR} AGAINST {AGAINST} ABSTAIN {BLANK} PRESENT {PRESENT} DID_NOT_VOTE {DID NOT VOTE} other {{secondVote}}}); the first is kept.} other {Two sources state different things; the source of higher precedence wins.}}
messages.NO_STORED_FACTS: {missing} of {total} documents were read before facts were stored; re-poll the meeting to derive attendance and votes. The stored rows were left as they are.
messages.LAYOUT_DISAGREES: The body's conventions say the roll call is printed as «{expected, select, composition_and_absent {Composition and absent} present_and_absent {Present and absent} present_only {Present only} mixed {Mixed} other {{expected}}}», but this document printed it as «{found, select, composition_and_absent {Composition and absent} present_and_absent {Present and absent} present_only {Present only} mixed {Mixed} other {{found}}}».
messages.ITEM_NUMBER_DISAGREES: The document states it decided agenda item {declared} but is linked to item {linked}; if the link is wrong, every fact the document carries sits on the wrong subject.

composition_and_absent.label: Composition and absent
composition_and_absent.description: The page prints the body's full composition (ΣΥΝΘΕΣΗ) and then who was absent.
composition_and_absent.hint: This administrative body's documents usually print attendance as a full ΣΥΝΘΕΣΗ roster followed by who was absent.

present_and_absent.label: Present and absent
present_and_absent.description: The page prints a ΠΑΡΟΝΤΕΣ list and an ΑΠΟΝΤΕΣ list.
present_and_absent.hint: This administrative body's documents usually print attendance as separate ΠΑΡΟΝΤΕΣ and ΑΠΟΝΤΕΣ lists.

present_only.label: Present only
present_only.description: The page prints only who was present.
present_only.hint: This administrative body's documents usually print attendance as a ΠΑΡΟΝΤΕΣ list only.

mixed.label: Mixed
mixed.description: The layout varies between documents of this body.
mixed.hint: This administrative body's documents print attendance in no single layout.

opening.label: Opening roll call
opening.description: The present list is who was there when the session opened; arrivals are stated separately.
opening.hint: The present list is the opening roll call; arrivals are stated separately.

cumulative.label: Cumulative
cumulative.description: The present list includes everyone who attended at any point of the session.
cumulative.hint: The present list includes everyone who attended at any point; do not read it as the opening roll call.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: Not settled yet; attendance is derived as an opening roll call and flagged until a person confirms.

attendanceChangeAnchors.fieldLabel: Arrivals and departures are pinned to

phase.label: a phase of the session
phase.description: «πριν την έναρξη της ημερήσιας διάταξης», «κατά τα θέματα εκτός ημερήσιας διάταξης»

anchors.some: Arrivals and departures, when stated, are pinned to:
anchors.none: They rarely state arrivals or departures.

statesPerDecisionAttendance.label: Lists who was present for this decision
statesPerDecisionAttendance.description: At the end of the document the page names every member present for this decision (ΤΑ ΜΕΛΗ, ΑΠΟΧΩΡΗΣΑΝΤΕΣ).
statesPerDecisionAttendance.hint: At the end of the document, after the decision text, they list every member present for this decision (ΤΑ ΜΕΛΗ / ΑΠΟΧΩΡΗΣΑΝΤΕΣ); return that list as decisionAttendance and leave the opening roll call in presentMembers.

statesPerVoteAbsence.label: States per-vote absence
statesPerVoteAbsence.description: «Κατά τη διαδικασία της ψηφοφορίας απουσίαζε…» printed after the decision.
statesPerVoteAbsence.hint: They print who was absent for this decision's vote after the decision («Κατά τη διαδικασία της ψηφοφορίας απουσίαζε…»); report those as absent_for_vote.

usesSubstitutes.label: Uses substitutes
usesSubstitutes.description: Substitute members (αναπληρωματικά μέλη) may sit for absent regular members.
usesSubstitutes.hint: Substitute members (αναπληρωματικά μέλη) sit for absent regular members and vote only while that member is absent. When the page says a replaced member arrived, also report the substitute's departure with the same anchor and the same timing as that arrival (type departure), quoting the substitution sentence («… αναπληρώθηκε από …»).

mayorStatedSeparately.label: Mayor stated separately
mayorStatedSeparately.description: The mayor's presence is stated in its own sentence, never in the member lists.
mayorStatedSeparately.hint: The mayor is stated in a separate sentence, never in the member lists.

none.label: Nobody named
none.description: The page names no voters; only the phrase.

dissenters_only.label: Dissenters only
dissenters_only.description: Only those against, blank or declaring are named.
dissenters_only.hint: They name only dissenters and declarations; nobody in favour is listed.

all.label: Every voter
all.description: Every voter is named, including those in favour.
all.hint: They name every voter, including those in favour.
